Plants of the World Online account: Equisetum × litorale Kühlew. ex Rupr..

The native range of this hybrid is Subarctic & Temp. Northern Hemisphere. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is E. arvense × A. fluviatile.
